record.title: Oman initial COVID selective entry prohibition
record.exceptions: Omani citizens; GCC citizens only under the initial March 17 rule, before the noon March 18 tightening.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.context: The initial March 17 rule exempted GCC citizens. A successor rule effective noon March 18 restricted entry to Omani citizens and prohibited their departure. October 1 reporting described conditional citizen and resident travel, without establishing uniform operational restoration.
record.uncertainty: The initial rule was strengthened on March 18, not ended by reopening. Conditional October 1 land-travel guidance does not establish a uniform observed endpoint. The record remains distinct from the January 2021 closure and does not assume the later direct Saudi road was operating.
